SomaticSniper 1.0.5.0: bam-somaticsniper
Licence: MIT (LICENSE in this folder). It contains SAMtools 0.1.6 (MIT: LICENSE.samtools, with LICENSE.bgzf and
LICENSE.razf) and is built with zlib 1.3.1 (LICENSE.zlib); the loader is Emscripten's runtime (MIT and NCSA:
LICENSE.emscripten). THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt lists them.
Upstream source: https://github.com/genome/somatic-sniper (tag v1.0.5.0, commit 136bac782dc2a761f63fa29cfd8ff1d1e162faf5)

Compiled to WebAssembly by the genomics-wasm project (https://github.com/comparativechrono/genomics-wasm,
commit bfacba3): Emscripten 3.1.64, one thread. The module (somaticsniper.mjs, somaticsniper.wasm) is used here as
that project built it: the page runs each command in a worker of its own (assets/js/threads-worker.mjs). Everything
needed to build it again is described in ../../../licenses/genomics-wasm-build/.

Changes to the source (tools/somaticsniper/browser.patch and samtools.patch there): the three file arguments are
checked, and a reference or BAM file that cannot be read, or a BAM header that is not valid, ends the program with a
message and status 1 – upstream can crash, or loop, there. The calling model, the pileup and the output are
unchanged; the probabilities keep upstream's long double.

In the workbench's terminal the program is called bam-somaticsniper, its name upstream (somaticsniper does the same).

Checked against SomaticSniper 1.0.5.0 built natively from the same sources (genomics-wasm's comparison: 11 of 11
cases with the HCC1395 tumour/normal reads; and in the workbench with the example data): the same VCF records.
